text_block_list.name: Daring Tact & Kiseki
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Man, Triple Tiara horsegirls 
really are something else!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Daring Tact! 
Now I'm really pumped to see how things 
develop from here.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Would you race me again sometime soon?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... who knows about that? 
I'm actually thinking of heading overseas!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
! 
Overseas...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Going overseas is amazing! 
Experiencing cultures you've never known 
before 
gives you all kinds of wild inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Experience isn't something you can just 
build overnight, 
but... if you throw yourself out into the 
world, 
you get such a concentrated dose of it.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm breaking out of Japan! 
All to create the most incredible, 
thrilling races possible!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact had poured every ounce of her 
strength into the race. 
Yet when she returned, 
there was a distant look in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Achieving something even greater than the 
Triple Tiara... 
That was the resolution we set back at New 
Year's, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
In other words... to show everyone who 
supports me 
an even bigger, more grand dream.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
And perhaps... winning an overseas race 
is one way to achieve that?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Out in this vast world, there are 
heights that 
no Japanese horsegirl has ever reached 
before.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If I... if a Triple Tiara horsegirl 
were to achieve victory in a race like 
that...!
choice_data_list:
We could show them an immense, 
unforgettable dream!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was certainly an enticing challenge. 
With Daring Tact's caliber, 
she stood a real chance at victory abroad.
choice_data_list:
(Though I'd originally envisioned domestic 
races for our next target...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Victoria Mile: a GⅠ race on the Tiara 
circuit, 
essentially the championship to decide the 
spring tiara champion. 
I had planned to build even greater 
prestige there.
choice_data_list:
...Could you give me a little time to 
think it over?

...Could you give me a little time to 
think it over?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Racing overseas demands an incredible 
amount of preparation. 
Between rigorous physical monitoring and 
logistics, 
tackling every measure properly takes 
immense time.
choice_data_list:
I want to choose the path that benefits 
you most.

I want to choose the path that benefits 
you most.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I place myself entirely in 
your hands, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The objective "Finish in the top 3 at the 
Victoria Mile" 
has been canceled...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, 
our target race was put on hold for the 
time being.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —Well then, I'm heading out for my run!
choice_data_list: Right, focus on maintaining your pace!
Right, focus on maintaining your pace!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching Daring Tact train, I turned 
things over in my mind. 
Above all, her passion to take on the 
challenge 
was what mattered most.
choice_data_list:
(I should try asking a senior trainer for 
advice, too!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Hah... hah...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...All right, one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Hah...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—A subtle dissonance caught my attention. 
Watching Daring Tact run, 
something felt... slightly off.

title: After the Kinko Sho: A Greater Dream
